proposed_from.topic: Complete state-specific identification under observed-context CSIs. In finite positive semi-Markovian DAGs, require every CSI activation variable to be observed and substitute the fixed treatment/outcome assignments before partitioning contexts. Construct a terminating sound-and-complete procedure returning either an arithmetic observed-cell formula for P_x(y), or a verified observed LC-certificate: an activation-refining partition, CSI-authorized deletion traces, SUCCESS ID-Qfunc derivations or OBSTRUCTION rooted C-forest pairs for every relevant c-component, and two global positive algebraic CPT tables indexed by the input CSI row-equality quotient that induce the same P(V) but different queries. Prove global shared-row gluing, total formula recovery or a genuine forest obstruction, and finite complexity; generic real-algebraic decision without the context/C-forest characterization does not count. Use Chen-Darwiche 2026, Tikka et al. 2019, and Mokhtarian et al. 2022 as anchors, and Y0 as the software consumer. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: The observed-context restriction removes an exact hidden-activation obstruction. Global CSI CPT rows reduce to connected equality classes, and fixed-nuisance binary-sink countermodels reduce exactly to a rational row-space/nullspace test. Two positive rational examples were checked, with query gaps 1/30 and 3/200. Active pruning, shared-row identification, cancellation, positive denominators, fixed cardinalities, and empty-trace decoration were attacked; saturated local-forest reasoning fails, but the literal partial-trace/global-witness certificate survives. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Prove the finite global context-factor dichotomy: exhaustive sound reductions must yield a total arithmetic formula or partial-trace rooted-forest obstructions admitting jointly positive shared-row countermodels, without the forests becoming merely decorative generic algebraic witnesses. EARLY KILL TEST: Reproduce the five-node active-deletion example where the pruned graph has no hedge but the empty trace has one, then test a local bow whose target becomes identified through an observed reference context; failure to reject the false local countermodel, or inability to link the surviving forest to query separation, forces a pivot or stop. proposed_from.novelty_justification: The field-tier question is stronger than sound CSI search, strictly targets a domain beyond complete observed-root control, and seeks necessity for state-specific identification. Its established first slice replaces a promissory semantic pair by a forest-restricted rational row-space test, a canonical kernel direction, and an explicit positivity-controlled baseline perturbation. The reference-context bow is rejected because its query vector lies in the observed row space, so forests cannot survive merely as decorative witnesses.

seed_details.seed: Finite state-specific formula-or-observed-local-context-certificate completeness under observed endogenous activations
seed_details.anchor_read: The Introduction motivates fixed-state identification; Theorem 1 proves only soundness of the state-specific CSI procedure; Proposition 5 shows that an identified pruned CI-graph can correspond to a nonidentified original constrained query; the Conclusion claims no completeness theorem.
seed_details.changed_proof_step: Replace Chen and Darwiche's one-way Q-factor recovery after context pruning by a bidirectional finite residual-district dichotomy carrying original observed-cell provenance and global row identities.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for state-specific CSI completeness with observed endogenous activations found Chen--Darwiche's sound method and Mokhtarian et al.'s root-control theorem, but no complete formula-or-forest procedure for this target--method pair.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical referee says this is immediate from Mokhtarian et al. by conditioning on activation contexts.
seed_details.rebuttal: Their sufficiency and necessity both use roothood to equate intervention with conditioning on controls; endogenous activations invalidate those equalities, and Chen--Darwiche Proposition 5 blocks naive contextwise reduction.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The seed uses the SCM-native completeness shape rather than a bare do-calculus application; its named focal object is a verifiable formula-or-certificate algorithm.

seed_details.seed: Uniform positive shared-row lift from partial-trace rooted C-forests
seed_details.anchor_read: The paper's Introduction motivates CSI gains, Theorem 5 proves only soundness, Theorem 6 refutes independent context-graph identification, and the Conclusion asks for hedge-style completeness theory.
seed_details.changed_proof_step: Replace the independent XOR kernels in Shpitser--Pearl's hedge construction by a quotient-indexed perturbation jointly respecting all CSI-shared rows and prove that its query contraction is nonzero.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for positive shared-row hedge countermodels under CSI returned generic polynomial and arithmetic-circuit methods, but no uniform forest-grounded lift.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical referee says Shpitser and Pearl's parity construction already turns every forest into a positive countermodel.
seed_details.rebuttal: Their local kernels are chosen independently, while CSI forces transitive row sharing across contexts; explicit positive local contrasts can cancel after global recombination.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The claim is uniform over the full finite class and requires shared-row compatibility, so it is not a single hand-tuned witness.

seed_details.seed: Necessary-and-sufficient trace preservation for assignment-dependent CSI pruning
seed_details.anchor_read: Theorem 6 proves that identification in all context-specific DAGs is insufficient, locating the precise boundary at which context decomposition loses global information.
seed_details.changed_proof_step: Strengthen query-preserving pruning from one graph to a trace-indexed equivalence that recovers formulas from safe branches and lifts an earlier obstruction whenever a later active deletion destroys its hedge.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches combining CSI deletion traces with query-preserving pruning found Tikka--Karvanen's ordinary pruning and Chen--Barker's background-knowledge pruning, but no bidirectional shared-row trace theorem.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical referee says preserving all deletion orders trivially preserves both formulas and hedges.
seed_details.rebuttal: The five-node positive example shows that the maximal active trace loses the hedge, while the reference-context bow shows that retaining every local hedge creates false obstructions; the theorem must characterize which information and witnesses survive globally.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The seed demands both directions and an explicit recovery or lifting map.

seed_details.seed: Primal--dual row-space dichotomy for coordinated quotient perturbations across multiple CPT blocks
seed_details.anchor_read: The Introduction casts identification as invariance under parameter constraints; Theorem 1 proves invariant-cut completeness only for classical positivity; the Conclusion presents CSI handling through examples rather than a complete constrained theorem.
seed_details.changed_proof_step: Replace invariant-cut search on a compiled circuit by an exact tangent or elimination module whose primal output is a positive shared-row separator and whose dual output is an observed-cell arithmetic identity.
seed_details.destination_search: The destination pair appears only in general polynomial-program and circuit-invariance work; no quotient-aware exact multilinear duality for a fixed CSI causal cell was found.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical referee says this is standard elimination theory applied to finite causal parameters.
seed_details.rebuttal: Generic elimination does not yield an arithmetic observed-cell formula, a positive rational separator, or a forest-linked residual decomposition; all three are part of the proposed duality.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The seed names a computable primal--dual certificate rather than an unspecified algebraic decision.

seed_details.seed: Canonical connected row-quotient invariance for formulas and nonidentification certificates
seed_details.anchor_read: The paper's setup defines CSI as assignment-specific equality of local conditional behavior and develops local representations; its scope is probabilistic inference rather than latent causal-effect identification or certificates.
seed_details.changed_proof_step: After converting CSI syntax to local row equalities, take transitive connected components before context decomposition and prove invariance of both the observational fiber and every returned structural certificate.
seed_details.destination_search: LDAG and CStree equivalence papers cover observational or fully observed interventional representations, but no result found preserves latent fixed-query formulas and global model-pair certificates.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical referee says transitive closure of equality constraints is elementary.
seed_details.rebuttal: The quotient construction itself is elementary, but certificate invariance across latent observational fibers and deletion traces is not supplied by representation equivalence; the result is best retained as a lemma rather than the headline.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The seed is intentionally scoped as a supporting subfield result, not inflated into the main contribution.

seed_details.seed: Effective finite normal form and parameterized complexity in row-class and trace width
seed_details.anchor_read: Theorem 1 proves NP-hardness of CSI nonidentifiability, while the search algorithm terminates and the Discussion identifies feasibility as a separate challenge.
seed_details.changed_proof_step: Replace unrestricted calculus search by a finite normal form indexed by activation cells, connected row classes, residual districts, and nonrepeating partial traces, then analyze the resulting parameterized state space.
seed_details.destination_search: The literature contains general CSI hardness and fixed-root-control tractability, but no fixed-parameter result in quotient width or surviving trace width for state-specific completeness.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical referee says finiteness follows immediately because all variables have finite state spaces.
seed_details.rebuttal: Finite semantic parameter spaces do not bound symbolic formula search; a complete normal form must bound derivation length, expression size, and certificate encoding.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The named object is the effective normal-form bound, not a generic complexity remark.

seed_details.seed: Arithmetic descent from fiber constancy for positive observed-context CSI models
seed_details.anchor_read: The Introduction motivates general discrete causal computation; Theorem 1 proves sharpness of an encoded polynomial program; the discussion emphasizes numerical or polynomial optimization rather than symbolic rational descent on point-identified fibers.
seed_details.changed_proof_step: Start from constancy of the causal polynomial on every positive observational fiber and derive a globally total arithmetic observed-cell expression with certified positive denominators.
seed_details.destination_search: Polynomial programming and constrained-identification circuits decide or optimize fibers, but no theorem was found showing rational arithmetic descent for this exact CSI semi-Markovian image.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical referee says elimination automatically expresses every identified polynomial query rationally in observed cells.
seed_details.rebuttal: A polynomial map can have a fiber-constant target with only an algebraic inverse, so rationality and globally positive denominators require a model-specific theorem.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The seed does not assume the desired arithmetic representation; it makes descent itself the theorem.

seed_details.seed: Inference compiler for state-specific CSI formulas returned by the complete procedure
seed_details.anchor_read: The paper motivates estimability of fixed cells and returns symbolic formulas, but its results stop at identification and empirical identification counts rather than influence functions or regular inference.
seed_details.changed_proof_step: After a total observed-cell expression is returned, differentiate its finite positive-cell map and translate the derivative into an influence function with cross-fitted nuisance estimation where conditional cells are used.
seed_details.destination_search: Bhattacharya--Nabi--Shpitser cover estimation after ordinary hidden-variable identification, but no state-specific CSI formula compiler with trace-aware positivity diagnostics was found.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical referee says the delta method makes inference for any finite-cell rational functional immediate.
seed_details.rebuttal: For fixed finite positive cells the basic influence function is routine, so this is a downstream software contribution rather than the identification headline.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The estimator rung is correctly paired with the SCM identification shape rather than labeled as bare M8.

seed_details.seed: Completeness with one observed endogenous binary activation
seed_details.anchor_read: Theorem 1 proves completeness only when all controls are observed roots; its necessity proof concentrates root-control mass near a single context and invokes continuity.
seed_details.changed_proof_step: Replace the root-control concentration construction by a parent-aware observational-fiber coupling for one binary endogenous activation.
seed_details.destination_search: No theorem for even one endogenous observed control was found, although Chen--Darwiche's sound state-specific algorithm covers examples in that regime.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical referee says a one-control result is an incremental root-to-nonroot extension.
seed_details.rebuttal: The first changed proof step is genuinely different, but the restricted theorem is dominated by the full observed-activation kernel and is kept only as a possible fallback.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The seed is not used as the headline because a one-variable restriction would cap the contribution.
